# Allowlist of the unit-test gate for rule 4 (real resources in test files), issue #204.
#
# Each line is a test file that is legitimately outside the unit lane, with the one-line reason. The check is
# static and per file: it names the call, it does not prove the call runs in every test of the file.
# A listed file that no longer makes such a call is a WARNING (an error with -strict), so this list stays honest.
#
